seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [hazard,wall] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, x x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: state accumulated across earlier steps that the frame does not show. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks (colour-10 4x4) move together: A1/A2 y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together, mirrored by which half the block is in.
Click on an inactive marker (9) arms it: blocks turn into players (1), that marker turns active (11). Click on a player disarms. Any other click does nothing.
While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker's 4x4 cell by 4. Any move happens only if the destination 4x4 is all floor colour 5 (own cells excepted) within rows 1-62.
The marker A4 [hazard,wall] mixed outcome is decided by the colour of the destination cell. Accumulated hidden state plays no part in it.
HUD: zeros in row 0 from the right and in row 63 from the left, width (128a+150)//300. The action count a is hidden and continuity-gated through a 16-frame memo. Not confirmed: what triggers the level reset.
